title.value: High-Throughput and Energy-Efficient VLSI Architecture for Ordered Reliability Bits GRAND
title.justification: The title was chosen based on the focus of the paper which is the VLSI architecture for ORBGRAND, an error correction coding technique.
title.quote: High-Throughput and Energy-Efficient VLSI Architecture for Ordered Reliability Bits GRAND

extractions.description: The paper presents a VLSI architecture for the Ordered Reliability Bits GRAND (ORBGRAND) algorithm, focusing on decoding short-length high-rate channel codes crucial for applications like 5G. The proposed hardware architecture is capable of high throughput and energy efficiency, outperforming existing decoders in terms of efficiency, scalability, and performance, particularly for applications requiring ultra-reliable low-latency communication.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses advancements in communication technology, focusing on VLSI architectures for decoding algorithms without a direct emphasis on sustainable development or ecological impact.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC), a major 5G New-Radio use case, is the key enabler for applications with strict reliability and latency requirements.

primary_category.justification: The content of the paper primarily focuses on VLSI architectures and communication technology improvements rather than direct applications in climate or ecological sustainable development.
primary_category.quote: This work reports the first hardware architecture for ORBGRAND, which achieves an average throughput of up to 42.5 Gbps for a code length of 128 at a target FER of 10 ^{−7}.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not cover other aspects of climate or ecological sustainable development beyond its primary focus.
secondary_categories.quote: The proposed architecture enhances decoding performance by at least 2 dB and offers significant improvements in efficiency over existing solutions.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's content is centered on technological improvements in VLSI architecture for communication systems and does not align with specific climate or ecological sustainable development sub-categories.
primary_sub_category.quote: ORBGRAND is thus highly parallelizable and well suited to parallel hardware implementation.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The subject matter strictly pertains to communication technology and does not address broader environmental categories.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The proposed VLSI architecture achieves 49× higher decoding throughput, 32× higher energy efficiency and 5× higher area efficiency compared to the state-of-the-art.
